definitions.resource_medians: Median of five per-capture phase CPU rates and stable sampled peak RSS; CPU100% means one core. Stable samples remain original [1:-1] per phase; startup/oracle validation excluded. RSS is not lifetime peak, heap size or GPU residency.
definitions.cpu_timing: Optional timing build only: each original discrete per-run p99, then median of five p99 values; CPU wall-clock draw/submission spans, excluding GPU/compositor completion. No pooled/interpolated quantile.
definitions.modes: Separate instrumentation-disabled resource and instrumentation-enabled timing runs; actual operation counts differ, so not a causal instrumentation-overhead experiment.
definitions.operation_counts: Actual recorded totals per capture, with every individual type retained; navigation/detail has no operation counter, so none is invented.
definitions.rounding: Machine record retains audited full precision; human CPU/RSS tables round to2decimals and timing tointeger microseconds.

limits: e205 is the frozen hosted Kael source; later source changes are excluded.
Four general desktop workloads lead; the editor workload remains supplemental historical coverage.

Operation counts are actual observed totals, not guaranteed equal between engines or captures. Navigation/detail does not record operation counters; render/frame counts are retained without inventing operation counts.
Timing builds and instrumentation-disabled builds remain separate fixed workloads, not a causal instrumentation-overhead experiment.
Different native headers, metadata scope, dock chrome, persistence and layout rules are disclosed; correctness/geometry acceptance does not prove feature or pixel parity.
CPU spans and sampled RSS are descriptive on this hosted virtual Mac. No overall winner, power efficiency, GPU/compositor time, physical-device/AT/IME input or visible presentation claim.
Frozen hosted source e2054aa17c8661fffd89c49e3d8433a5a7ba6008 and released GPUI Kit0.7.3 revision67265a36. Any later Kael or competitor changes are excluded.

One shared hosted virtual macOS runner. Exact CPU/memory metadata is preserved below. Five alternating repetitions per engine are descriptive within each fixed contract/mode, not an overall framework ranking or controlled bare-metal power comparison.
Actual phase-boundary geometry is derived below from the raw reports; nominal1100x760 fixture metadata alone is not geometry proof.

The display inventory is empty. Accepted owned foreground requests and mandatory active/churn repaint gates were verified; this is not independent proof of foreground focus, native monitor presentation, GPU completion, compositor latency, or visible smoothness.
CPU draw/submission durations are CPU-side wall-clock spans recorded with optional instrumentation, not GPU time or end-to-end latency. Timing-enabled and timing-disabled builds are kept separate.
Stable sampled RSS excludes startup and oracle validation, and is process RSS rather than retained heap, allocator usage, GPU residency, or an exact high-water mark.
Startup timings lack matched initial geometry and are not summarized as comparative results.
Application executable bytes were uploaded and independently rehashed against every capture. This verifies binary identity, not visible compositor presentation or GPU time.
Unavailable/zero-only counters are reported explicitly from this run and are not converted to watts or used to rank energy efficiency.

The fixed phase schedule and original operation-coverage gates do not guarantee equal operation counts across captures or engines. Actual per-run counts and native component differences are retained; modes are not a controlled instrumentation-overhead experiment.

Native component contracts preserve documented differences such as data-header height, tree accessibility metadata scope and dock chrome. Passing the original oracle/geometry gates does not establish pixel-identical rendering or complete feature parity.

The job restored a target cache and only logs compilation of the GPUI comparison harness. The exact locked GPUI Kit source pin and preserved competitor source archive are checked independently. This is not a fresh GPUI Kit dependency compilation or cache-object provenance attestation.
This successful comparison workflow is separate from the broader Platform Validation workflow; no whole-platform acceptance follows.
